**Review: Pebblebrook Tea Co., product page, Chamomile and Lemon Balm**

Nothing needs changing. Every claim is on the allowlist or counts as a product fact.

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association" | Allowlisted, exact wording (certificate renewed 2026) |
| "plastic-free tea bags" | Allowlisted (supplier certificate, EN 13432) |
| "20 plastic-free tea bags" (count) | Product fact (pack size) |
| "caffeine-free blend" | Product fact (ingredients) |
| "gentle, honeyed" | Flavour description, product fact |
| "for the evening" | Serving suggestion. It doesn't claim sleep, calm or relaxation, so it isn't a health claim. |

**Other checks**
- **Superlatives, guarantees, urgency, invented numbers or testimonials:** none.
- **Health claims:** none. Keep it this way: don't add "calming", "helps you sleep" or "soothing", which would be health claims.
- **Green claims:** "plastic-free" is the approved wording. No general "eco-friendly" or "sustainable" claims.
- **Banned words and structures:** none. No "indulge", "elevate", "unlock" or "journey", and no "not just X, it's Y". No exclamation marks or rhetorical openers.
- **Spelling and voice:** UK spelling, and the tone is plain and unhurried.
- **Disclosures:** a first-party product page needs none.
- **Approval:** as with all public content, Sam needs to sign off before it goes live.
